note: Shared defaults every migration run inherits from this scaffold, identical for every run. These are configured values, not measurements: nothing here says a model, image or workspace is ready; preflight measures that. A run's identity is not here either: the Developer Hub factory writes run-budget.json into the destination's initial commit, and that commit is when the budget is declared. See .hermes/lib/planner/run_declaration.py.

budget.clock: earlier of destination first commit and M1 dispatch; includes bootstrap

m5_delivery.note: assisted continuation after M4 close; separate from the 24h migration deadline; do not extend or rewrite that deadline

budget.in_workspace_stops: v32 (2026-10-03): these two limits are enforced inside the workspace by .hermes/kernel/run_budget.py on every dispatcher tick (an on_kanban_dispatch_tick hook the Stage 050 producer registers), never by a lead watching from outside. run_input_token_budget: prompt tokens of every kanban worker session of the run; 250000000 = 36 cards x ~7M (the largest healthy Qwen 3.8 implementer run, 6M, plus a review), a judgement. no_accepted_checkpoint_minutes: 240 = two consecutive runs at the 2h per-card max runtime (a run and its retry, or a run and its review), a judgement. A stop blocks every running or ready card with its named reason (MIGRATION_TOKEN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, MIGRATION_NO_ACCEPTED_CHECKPOINT) until an Operator lifts it (run_budget.py lift, recorded in run-stops.jsonl beside the request ledger). The wall budget is declared and reported but enforced by nothing in the workspace.
stopping_conditions: terminal M4 outcome in both modes; full and provisional outcomes reported separately
sealed unit or family retry budget exhausted
M5 PREFLIGHT/DEPLOY/VALIDATE stage runtime exhausted (1h/3h/1h, max_retries 1)
run input-token budget exhausted (MIGRATION_TOKEN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, enforced in the workspace)
no card accepted for no_accepted_checkpoint_minutes (MIGRATION_NO_ACCEPTED_CHECKPOINT, enforced in the workspace)
budget.continuation: live repair, rewind or harness replacement is an assisted continuation; preserve the initial deadline and record
